items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: (To the question) It was explained in the previous answer, that the power of the ending of the feet of Leah, which spreads into the territory of Rachel, saves her from descending to Beriah, see there. And behold, all this was possible only while they were two Partzufim, namely, before the long NHY of Ima spread in Leah, when also Aba and Ima and Yeshsut were two special Partzufim, in which Aba and Ima were face-to-face in another wall of the posteriors of Ima upon the light of Hochma, and Leah received from these posteriors of Ima, which is the aspect of her wall of the HGT, whose principal power is revealed upon the end of Leah, called the feet of Leah; and these feet entered into the territory of Rachel and held her in Atzilut, as above in the adjacent answer. However, now, at the time of the coupling of midnight, when Aba and Ima and Yeshsut have already become one Partzuf, and the NHY of Ima have become long, whose meaning is that they became the aspect of AB, it is found that Ima herself has already ceased her posteriors that reject Hochma; and therefore, after the clothing of the long NHY of Ima in Leah, and she spread and also took the place of the NHY of ZA, which are the nine Sefirot of the additions of Rachel, and they became HGT and NHY for one body of Leah, then all the power of the posteriors from the feet of Leah has already ceased, and she cannot press and conceal the aspect of the posteriors of Rachel, her house; and therefore now the Keter of Rachel herself descended to Beriah, because the power of the screen of the second restriction, which takes out the AHP of the NHY to the aspect of BYA, was revealed upon her, as above in the adjacent answer. And this is [the meaning of] "that it is impossible for one part of the body to spread and clothe in another part of itself," because now, after Leah also took the part of the NHY of ZA to her body, and the power of the posteriors of Ima ceased from her, as above, she no longer has the power to arouse her posteriors, in order to conceal the aspect of the posteriors of the NHY in the Keter of Rachel, since there are in her two aspects opposite to one another; for this is not conceivable at all in the spiritual, that two aspects differing from one another should be doubled in one place. (Item 37).
